name: Codex Ppt
summary: Generate visually unified image-based PPT/PPTX decks from articles, reports, papers, notes, or outlines.

name: Image To Editable Ppt
summary: Rebuild slide images, scanned or image-based PPT/PPTX files, and PDF decks into object-level editable PowerPoint (.pptx), preserving speaker notes when supplied. Use for making visual slides editable or reconstructing slides from screenshots; not for authoring new presentations from scratch.
